item.title: Apple CEO Ternus on Design, AI, and iPhone Duo
item.description: Explore how Apple’s new CEO John Ternus is reshaping product design, AI integration, and the iPhone Duo’s playful features to enhance user experience.

item.title: Apple Introduces Reachability for iPhone Duo via Update
item.description: Apple will roll out the Reachability feature to its dual‑screen iPhone Duo later this year, improving one‑hand use across both displays and UI.

item.description: Apple's first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, offers performance and a dual‑display experience, but its price, compromises, and app support spark debate.

item.title: Apple Store Walk‑In Limits for iPhone Duo Launch
item.description: Apple will stock limited iPhone Duo units for walk‑in shoppers in 16 markets on Oct 23, using reservations elsewhere to curb crowds and scalpers.

item.title: iPhone Duo Cases & Protectors: Best Deals & Reviews
item.description: Find top iPhone Duo cases and screen protectors from OtterBox, ZAGG, Speck, with pricing, discounts and buying tips for pre‑order shoppers today.

item.title: iPhone Duo Gains Apple Pencil Support in iOS 27.2
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Duo will finally support the USB‑C Apple Pencil with iOS 27.2, unlocking drawing, annotation and scrolling on both screens now.

item.title: Apple Support App Now Optimized for iPhone Duo
item.description: Apple updates its Support app to fix letterboxing on the iPhone Duo’s wide screen and adds Split View, enhancing multitasking and user experience.

item.title: iPhone Duo Edge Light Acts as Virtual Ring Light
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Duo inherits the Edge Light feature from silicon Macs, creating a virtual ring light that brightens faces during FaceTime calls.

item.title: iPhone Duo Tips Over on MagSafe Stands When Unfolded
item.description: Upright MagSafe chargers can tip the unfolded iPhone Duo due to uneven weight, while flat pads stay stable; stands may add ledges for support.

item.title: iPhone Duo’s Hidden Front Camera: Trash Photos, Video
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Duo adds an under‑display front camera, but reviewers call its photos low‑res and washed‑out, sparking doubts about the tech’s practicality.

item.title: iPhone Duo Review: Apple’s First Foldable Phone
item.description: A deep dive into Apple’s iPhone Duo, the company’s first foldable phone, exploring its notebook chassis, iPad‑like inner screen, and impact.

item.title: iPhone Duo Gets Apple Pencil Support in iOS 27.2
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Duo will support the Apple Pencil with iOS 27.2, a shift that expands mobile creativity and signals deeper iOS hardware integration.

item.title: iPhone Duo Gains Reachability Feature Later This Year
item.description: Apple will add Reachability to the iPhone Duo later this year, enhancing one‑handed use and reinforcing its ergonomic design, expanding accessibility.

item.title: Where Apple’s iPhone Duo Will and Won’t Accept Walk‑Ins
item.description: An look at Apple’s iPhone Duo walk‑in policy, why store availability matters, technical logistics, and what it signals for the mobile global market.

item.title: Apple iPhone Duo Review: First Foldable iPhone Unveiled
item.description: Apple’s $1,999 iPhone Duo adds a titanium dual‑screen, A20 Pro chip and iOS 27 multitasking, yet its weight, price and app gaps spark debate.

item.title: Apple Launches Home View Hub, TV 4K & iPhone Duo

item.title: Apple's iPhone Duo Retail Showcase Amid Limited Supply

item.title: Apple iPhone Duo Features Replaceable Nano‑Texture Cover

item.title: Apple iPhone Duo Foldable: Crease Visibility Test
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Duo foldable adds a nano‑textured matte screen to hide the hinge crease, yet early hands‑on tests question durability and visibility.

item.title: Apple iPhone Duo: Design, Engineering, and Industry Impact

item.title: MacRumors & iMazing Giveaway: Win iPhone Duo + Software
item.description: Enter the MacRumors x iMazing giveaway for a chance to win the new iPhone Duo and a full iMazing license, plus ten extra software copies globally.

item.title: Xcode 27.1 Beta Brings iPhone Duo Support to Developers
item.description: Apple's Xcode 27.1 beta adds iPhone Duo SDKs, simulators, and macOS 26.6+ support, reshaping iOS development for the upcoming dual‑screen device.

item.title: Apple VP Tom Marieb Details iPhone Duo Durability
item.description: Apple’s VP Tom Marieb details the iPhone Duo’s hinge, durability testing, and display‑crease mitigation, raising the bar for foldable phones.

item.title: Apple Unveils iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Duo & New CEO
item.description: Apple's September 9 event reveals the iPhone 18 Pro with a mechanical aperture, the foldable iPhone Duo, and marks John Ternus' debut as CEO.

item.title: Apple Announces Foldable iPhone Duo & iPhone 18 Pro
item.description: Apple's 2026 event launches the foldable iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max, Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and AirPods 5, reshaping mobile tech.

item.title: Apple & Shine Event: Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Watch 12

item.title: Apple’s iPhone Duo Leak & iPhone 18 Pro Colors Unveiled
item.description: Mark Gurman’s Bloomberg leak names Apple’s upcoming iPhone Duo and predicts the iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max color lineup ahead of the Surprise & Shine event.

item.title: Apple Launches iPhone Duo Foldable: Design & Tech
item.description: Apple’s Media Showcase reveals the iPhone Duo, its crease‑free folding display, Touch ID redesign, revamped Siri AI, and new Apple Watch models.

item.title: Apple’s iPhone Duo: The First Folding iPhone Launch
item.description: Apple unveils the iPhone Duo, its first folding smartphone, promising a book‑like design and media‑optimized experience amid a declining foldable market.

item.title: Apple Launches iPhone Duo: First Foldable iPhone
item.description: Apple's iPhone Duo brings a 5.4‑inch closed screen and a 7.6‑inch unfolded display, debuting Apple's foldable phone and reshaping the mobile market.
